{{Quote|The Chimaera is fully at your command, Admiral.''"<br />"''Then prepare the fleet for hyperspace. And for battle.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Battle of Bilbringi''', was the final battle of the [[Thrawn campaign]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] between the [[Thrawn's confederation|forces]] under [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] and the combined forces of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|military]] and the [[Smugglers' Alliance]]. It was the second engagement at [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]] fought between the two sides during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The battle was fought at the [[Bilbringi Shipyards|Imperial shipyards]] for the sole reason that both the New Republic and Smuggler's Alliance desired to capture a [[crystal gravfield trap]] (CGT), a device that would allow the New Republic to uncover the location of cloaked objects and also uncloak the asteroids that Thrawn had set in orbit over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]<ref name="TLC" /> during the Coruscant siege.

A consummate strategist, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] accurately predicted the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic assault fleet]] would target [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]], while a concurrent New Republic attack on the Imperial [[Ubiqtorate/Legends|Ubiqtorate]] base on [[Tangrene]] would be a feint.<ref name="TLC" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|It was nearly a terrible defeat. We got decanted early by Imperial interdictors, too far from the shipyards. Thrawn wasn't even supposed to be there at all-we'd set it up ten different ways to make it look like we were going to hit Tangrene. But Thrawn was spooky that way. Absolutely brilliant. If he hadn't been assassinated by his own body-guard during the battle, there's no way we would have won.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>}}
The Grand Admiral's fleet arrived at Bilbringi to prepare to set a trap for the Rebels. Thrawn instructed his [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor Cruisers]] and Interdictor Star Destroyers to activate their gravity well projectors in anticipation of the imminent [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] attack. As anticipated by Thrawn, the New Republic assault fleet came out of hyperspace outside the Bilbringi perimeter.<ref name="TLC" />

[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] realized the New Republic fleet had come out of hyperspace too early, and too far out from the Imperial Shipyards. In the distance, a large Imperial fleet was arrayed before the New Republic forces. Several Interdictors were strategically positioned to prevent any escape. At once, Admiral Ackbar recognized the trap.<ref name="TLC" />

Grand Admiral Thrawn ordered the Interdictor Cruisers [[Constrainer/Legends|''Constrainer'']] and [[Sentinel (Interdictor cruiser)|''Sentinel'']], that were the farthest from the main fleet, to secure from entrapment duty and return to the demarcation line, where they would be protected. Then, the Grand Admiral instructed all Imperial warships to engage the enemy fleet.<ref name="TLC" />

The Imperial fleet was arrayed in a bowl-shaped formation with the Interdictors forming the outer ring. As the battle began, the Imperial forces hammered the New Republic warships, which were hastily assembled into battle formation and caught in the confusion. For much of the battle, the fight was going clearly in favor of the Imperial fleet.<ref name="TLC" />

[[File:RukhAndThrawn-GS3.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Rukh, shortly before he assassinated Thrawn.]]
Unfortunately for the Empire and unbeknownst to Thrawn, the [[Smugglers' Alliance|Smuggler's Alliance]] had already infiltrated the Bilbringi shipyards in their own attempt to seize the CGT and decided to aid the New Republic fleet by directly attacking the Imperial shipyards with the help of [[Rogue Squadron]] and some New Republic ships. The four Imperial [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun|Golan II]] platforms that protected the shipyards were unable to hold back the swift attack and the Imperial defensive line was breached.<ref name="TLC" />

This tactical change forced the Imperial fleet to divert some of its warships and starfighters to protect the shipyards. Thrawn's second-in-command, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], was dismayed by the sudden change of fortunes but the Grand Admiral reminded him that the battle was far from over.<ref name="TLC" />

Despite Grand Admiral Thrawn's genius, the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] was defeated when Thrawn's bodyguard, a [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] named [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]], assassinated him aboard the bridge of the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] at the height of the battle. As Captain Pellaeon read aloud an incoming report from [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] that indicated that Thrawn's cloning facility was under attack by a group that included Noghri, Rukh temporarily incapacitated the Captain with a swift blow to the throat. Rukh then stabbed his long assassin's knife into Thrawn, pinning and killing the Grand Admiral.<ref name="TLC" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|But&hellip;it was so artistically done&hellip;|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] last words|<ref name="TLC" />}}
[[File:ThrawnDeath-TLC6.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The assassination of Grand Admiral Thrawn.]]

Rukh himself was killed by the ''Chimaera's'' [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], led by a [[Grodin Tierce (clone)|clone]] of former [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]] [[Grodin Tierce]] while trying to escape.<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref> Although the fleets were still nearly evenly matched, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] realized that the Imperial line could not hold without Thrawn. With the New Republic forces gaining the initiative and many [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] requesting new orders in light of the tactical change, Pellaeon assumed command and ordered a full retreat towards the Unknown Regions.<ref name="TLC" /> He would later participate in [[Operation Shadow Hand]].

It was [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]' actions at the battle that led [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] to promote him to the rank of [[General/Legends|general]] and give him command of [[Rogue Wing]].<ref name="Dark Empire Sourcebook">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
